look_here_first: Start with the leaves: smooth to glabrous sessile leaves with rounded bases visibly clasp the stem. Yellow rays often show a reddish-brown basal eye around the raised dark cone.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: sessile leaves with rounded clasping bases

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: yellow rays often with dark basal eye

lookalikes.differences: The clasping leaf bases are the fastest separator; do not use yellow ray color alone.
